question: Among the various sources of Aryan culture, ________ is prominent.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ritual Book**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **ritual books**, particularly the **Vedas**, are the most prominent and primary sources of Aryan culture.
 
• These** ancient texts provide comprehensive insights into the religious, social, and cultural aspects of the Aryan**s.
 
• **The Vedas**, composed in Sanskrit, include:
 
 
• **Rigveda**: Hymns and praises to deities.
 
• **Samaveda**: Musical chants.
 
• **Yajurveda**: Ritual instructions.
 
• **Atharvaveda**: Spells and charms.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Memorial**

 
 
• Refers to structures or monuments built to commemorate individuals or events.
 
• Examples include stupas, pillars, or cenotaphs.
 
 
 
• **Inscription**
 
 
• Inscriptions are written records carved on stones, metals, or other durable materials.
 
• They became significant in later periods, especially during the Maurya and Gupta eras.
 
 
 
• **Archaeological Artifacts**
 
 
• Refers to tools, pottery, ornaments, and other physical remains discovered at archaeological sites.
 
• While artifacts provide valuable insights into ancient lifestyles, the Aryans left limited physical evidence since they were primarily nomadic or semi-nomadic in their early phases.
 
• Their cultural legacy is predominantly preserved in their ritual texts, not artifacts.
